b1.name: Triage new Linear bugs

steps.name: Get new bug issues
steps.does: Read the Linear issues labelled bug that are new since the last run

steps.name: Triage each bug
steps.does: Triage each issue into P0 to P3 with a reason

steps.name: Is it P0
steps.does: Check whether the triage says P0

steps.name: Post P0 to Slack
steps.does: Post each P0 issue to Slack #oncall

steps.name: Save the rest
steps.does: Put the other issues in a data table

assumptions: The issues read are the ones changed since the last run
The data table is the person's to pick

b4.name: Orders by size

steps.name: Total over 1000
steps.does: Branch on whether the order total is over 1000

steps.name: Send to VIP
steps.does: POST the whole order with vip true to http://127.0.0.1:3399/vip

steps.name: Reply ok
steps.does: Respond to the webhook with {"ok": true}

assumptions: The webhook answers after the VIP POST: a step follows one step

b8.name: Support chat

steps.name: Chat message
steps.does: Start when a chat message arrives

steps.name: Support triage agent
steps.does: Have the Support triage agent answer the message

steps.name: Could not answer
steps.does: Check whether the agent could not answer

steps.name: Person approves
steps.does: Hand what the agent could not answer to a person for approval

assumptions: The agent's answer is the chat's reply

steps.name: Set greeting
steps.does: Set a field greeting to Good morning
